description: This file defines the iCal class for generating iCalendar (VEVENT, VTODO, VTIMEZONE) strings for user calendar data, including events and tasks, within the SuiteCRM platform. It extends the vCal class and incorporates functions for formatting dates, handling time zones, creating calendar entries for meetings, calls, and tasks, and exporting the calendar as an iCal string.

classes.name: iCal
classes.description: A class that constructs iCalendar format strings for user calendar data, including events, tasks, and timezone information, within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that invokes the parent vCal constructor.

methods.name: getUtcDateTime
methods.description: Converts a SugarDateTime object into a UTC-formatted string based on UTC_FORMAT.

methods.name: getUtcTime
methods.description: Converts a timestamp into a UTC-formatted string, considering user timezone adjustments.

methods.name: convertMinsToHoursAndMins
methods.description: Converts minutes into a formatted string representing hours and minutes with sign.

methods.name: createSugarIcalTodo
methods.description: Creates a VTODO entry for a given task or project task, including due date, priority, and description.

methods.name: createSugarIcal
methods.description: Generates the calendar entries for events and tasks within a specified date range and user.

methods.name: getUserTimezone
methods.description: Retrieves the timezone string for the given user.

methods.name: getDSTRange
methods.description: Determines the daylight savings start and end transitions for a user in a given year.

methods.name: getTimezoneString
methods.description: Creates the full timezone component for the iCal, including daylight savings adjustments.

methods.name: getVcalIcal
methods.description: Generates the complete iCalendar string for a user over a specified number of months, including events, calls, meetings, and tasks.
